title: AesRec: A Dataset for Aesthetics-Aligned Clothing Outfit Recommendation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the ranking exposure gap (ExpoGap) between high-aesthetic and low-aesthetic clothing outfit groups to identify algorithmic bias toward recommending low-aesthetic items.

Evaluating systematic discrepancies in scoring scales between Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and human annotators by comparing their rating means and standard deviations, and applying a linear transformation to eliminate the bias.
